full_judgment: 2. The facts, as stated in the petition, in short, are that the present opposite party No. 1 Shahar Banoo Ziwar Sultan Bayed made a complaint to Kotwali Police Station through Co-ordination and Control Cell on 5-2-79 stating that the present petitioner was her monthly tenant in House No. 252, Road No. 22  Dhanmondi R/A, Dhaka. While she was abroad (in Iran) for about 7 years the petitioner taking advantage of her absence from Bangladesh, created a false Bainapatra, showing a contract for sale of the said house worth seven lakh taka, for a sum of Taka 25,000.00 only by the opposite party No. 1 in favour of the petitioner. On the basis of that bainapatra the petitioner brought Title Suit No. 48 of 1973/6 of 1986 for specific performance of contract against the opposite party No. 1 and also obtained an ex parte decree by suppressing summons from the opposite party No. 1. On her return to Bangladesh Shahar Banoo Ziwar Sultan Bayed became aware of the forgery for the first time. On an application by her in the civil Court the ex parte decree was set aside. The said suit has been pending in the Civil Court since 1973.
